queries.question: Which customers have placed more than 10 orders, and what is their total order value?
queries.sql_query:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_order_value
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 10;

queries.question: Which suppliers provide products that are frequently ordered together in the same order?
queries.sql_query:
SELECT s.company_name, p.product_name, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN public.suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN (
    SELECT od1.order_id, od1.product_id
    FROM public.order_details od1
    JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id <> od2.product_id
    GROUP BY od1.order_id, od1.product_id
) as frequent_orders ON od.product_id = frequent_orders.product_id
GROUP BY s.company_name, p.product_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
queries.final_answer: It seems there are no suppliers whose products are frequently ordered together in the same order based on the current data.
